## Assumptions Applied (Best-of-Research)
- .NET 10 SDK with `dotnet` CLI used for scaffold (`dotnet new blazorserver`)
- SQL Server LocalDB used for DEV; full SQL Server for UAT/PROD
- BCrypt.Net-Next NuGet for password hashing
- MudBlazor 7.x (latest stable) for UI components
- Dapper 2.x for data access
- `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` for SQL Server connectivity
- `MailKit` / `MimeKit` for email invitation sending
- Session auth via cookie + custom `AuthenticationStateProvider`
- All migration scripts idempotent (safe to re-run)
- Manufacturing starter template seeded via `Seed_ManufacturingTemplate.sql`
